message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc reported earnings reaction 2 actual of 2.87 on session 2026-05-20 [D1]. The company recorded earnings reaction 3 actual of 2.17 on session 2026-02-24 [D1]. Earnings reaction 4 actual was 1.91 on session 2025-11-25 [D1]. The latest earnings reaction actual figure stands at 2.82 for session 2026-08-19 [D1]. Keysight Technologies Inc announced participation in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on Friday, September 11, 2026 [D6]. The company also scheduled a fireside chat at the 2026 Truist Technology Symposium on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 [D6]. Keysight Collaborates with the Centre for Assuring Autonomy at the University of York to Advance AI Safety Assurance for Software-Defined Vehicles was announced on September 3, 2026 [D7].
